proposed_comments.title: Preserve the protected compatibility member
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve the protected compatibility member

**Severity:** `high`

`ListItemInitializationCoordinatorTests` still derives from this type and uses `UnsafeMoreCommands`, but the refactor renamed the protected member to `UnsafeContextItems`. The test project therefore fails with CS0103 on the current head. Keep the old protected name as an alias for the same backing list so existing derived helpers remain source-compatible.

```suggestion
    protected List<IContextItemViewModel> UnsafeMoreCommands => _contextItems;

    /// <summary>
```
